verdict.notes: Core same-subject cache bypass is demonstrated. Reproduction lacks explicit revision values and source-path/control coverage remains incomplete. One contradicted broad test inventory: supplied tests include document, host and value behavior beyond registry basics. Local source/contracts suffice for code-only claims; conditional native MCP adapter and functional empty-title/membership/retry observations are allowed. Batch all-or-nothing heading is corrected by explicit partial-effects description. Session TTL expiry language does not deny explicit close/shutdown removal.
unsupported_gap_claims: The existing tests only cover registry basics, so none of this is checked against a run. — The no-execution disclaimer is fine, but the exhaustive supplied-test inventory is false: document title updates/lists, host catalog/error journal and input validation have tests beyond registry basics. None establishes warmed cross-credential cache behavior. This is an inventory overstatement, not a missed exploit.
